title: Decomposing one-class support vector machine into an ensemble of one-data support vector machines
abstract: arXiv:2606.16002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: One-class Support Vector Machine(OCSVM) is a variant of support vector machine(SVM) for one-class classification (OCC). However, OCSVM has scalability issues with large datasets. This paper proposes an acceleration strategy for OCSVM. The idea is to decompose the dataset into samples and train OCSVM models for single data points. Subsequently, ensemble learning is applied to combine all models to compute the OCSVM model for the dataset. In addition, further acceleration is achieved through a support vector selection strategy with an OCSVM model trained on the average of the training samples. The experiment compared the proposal and traditional OCSVM using the Python package. The proposed strategy is faster than traditional OCSVM, while achieving similar classification results. Moreover, the proposed strategy can create a one-to-one correspondence between samples and models. Source code is uploaded at https://github.com/ToshiHayashi/O

translated_title: 将单类支持向量机分解为单数据支持向量机的集成
translated_abstract: 单类支持向量机（OCSVM）是支持向量机（SVM）用于单类分类（OCC）的一种变体。然而，OCSVM在大规模数据集上存在可扩展性问题。本文提出了一种OCSVM加速策略，其思想是将数据集分解为样本，并为单个数据点训练OCSVM模型，随后应用集成学习将所有模型组合起来，以计算整个数据集的OCSVM模型。此外，通过使用在训练样本均值上训练的OCSVM模型的支持向量选择策略，进一步实现了加速。实验使用Python包将所提方法与传统OCSVM进行了比较，结果表明所提策略比传统OCSVM更快，同时取得了相似的分类结果。此外，所提策略可以在样本与模型之间建立一一对应关系。源代码已上传至 https://github.com/ToshiHayashi/O
tldr: 本文提出将单类支持向量机分解为针对单个数据点的模型并利用集成学习重组，结合基于样本均值训练模型的支持向量选择策略，在保持相似分类效果的同时显著加速训练，并实现样本与模型的一一对应。
en_tdlr: This paper accelerates OCSVM by decomposing it into an ensemble of single-data-point models combined via ensemble learning, further boosted by a support vector selection strategy, achieving faster training with similar accuracy and a one-to-one correspondence between samples and models.
